content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Appeared in Madhyamik or equivalent examination; Candidates who failed Madhyamik or equivalent are also considered; Higher qualification allowed, but only Madhyamik marks are considered and give no extra advantage Age limit: Between 30 and 40 years for general candidates; between 22 and 40 years for SC and ST candidates (as on 25 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST Age limit 22 to 40 years as on 25-11-2026 Other conditions: Only women who are married, widowed or divorced by court decree may apply Must be a permanent resident of the specifically marked service area of the village concerned Only one application per candidate; multiple applications will all be cancelled Desirable: Preference to Grade-1 and Grade-2 self-help group members, trained dais and link workers with departmental certificate Preference to qualified SC/ST applicants in SC/ST-majority villages marked in the vacancy annexure

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Block Development Officer, Canning-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Unmarried women Applicants who are not permanent residents of the service area

rows.event: Last Date to Apply (by post, up to 5 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will Block Development Officer, Canning-I Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview of eligible candidates (called by letter sent by post) Only marks obtained in Madhyamik or equivalent examination are considered Interview date, time and venue sent by post to eligible candidates Originals of documents (a) to (f) must be shown on the interview day In SC/ST-majority villages, qualified SC/ST applicants get preference; if none, general candidates may be selected

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Birth certificate or Madhyamik/equivalent admit card Voter ID (EPIC) and ration card as proof of residence in the area Caste certificate (SC/ST) from competent authority, where applicable Madhyamik or equivalent marksheet Certificate of marital status; SHG/trained dai/link worker certificate where applicable Two signed passport photos, self-addressed envelope with Rs. 5 stamp, voter list part and serial number copy

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Block Development Officer, Canning-I Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application form given as Annexure-1 of the notice. Attach self-attested copies of all listed documents, two signed passport-size photos and a self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 5 stamp. Put the application in an envelope marked 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASHA FOR ... VILLAGE/SERVICE AREA UNDER ... HEALTH SUB-CENTRE'. Send it by speed post or registered post to The Block Development Officer, Canning I Development Block, Matla Char, Canning, PIN 743329. Application must be submitted by 15-12-2026, 5 PM; only postal applications are received.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Application without any one of the listed certificates will be cancelled Incomplete or erroneous applications will be rejected; no later request will be accepted Applications are received only by post at the BDO office

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Block Development Officer, Canning-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Block Development Officer, Canning-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 25 vacancies for ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Block Development Officer, Canning-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-1 of this notice (page 6)) and send it to The Block Development Officer, Canning I Development Block, Village: Matla Char, P.O.: Canning, P.S.: Canning, Dist.: South 24 Parganas, PIN: 743329, by speed post or registered post, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 30 and 40 years for general candidates; between 22 and 40 years for SC and ST candidates (as on 25 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST Age limit 22 to 40 years as on 25-11-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Not mentioned.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Must have appeared in Madhyamik or equivalent examination; candidates who failed Madhyamik are also considered; higher qualifications may apply but only Madhyamik marks are counted.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women who are married, widowed or divorced by court decree may apply. Must be a permanent resident of the specifically marked service area of the village concerned. Only one application per candidate; multiple applications will all be cancelled.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unmarried women. Applicants who are not permanent residents of the service area.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview of eligible candidates (called by letter sent by post). Only marks obtained in Madhyamik or equivalent examination are considered. Interview date, time and venue sent by post to eligible candidates. Originals of documents (a) to (f) must be shown on the interview day.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract-based engagement.
